raw_tail:
Reply 1 tells the reader to run the PowerShell port-check command and report the process name and PID it returns.
Reply 2 tells the reader to run the PowerShell port-check command and report back what it outputs (or that it output nothing).

If this were my problem, I would act on **Reply 1** first. 

Both replies correctly direct the user to run the same PowerShell command as the first step. However, judging strictly against the provided facts (which establish that the previous reply was correct and that a re-explanation should retain all four branches—killing the process, adding a shutdown handler, updating nodemon, and checking the Windows excluded port range—along with their commands in plainer words), Reply 1 fulfills all criteria by translating the entire troubleshooting sequence into simpler, plainer language without dropping information. In contrast, Reply 2 omits three of the commands and two entire troubleshooting branches (the shutdown handler and updating nodemon), deferring the explanation instead of providing it.
